notes.title: INASNIAS : New update
notes.content:
[h1]New version even more exciting![/h1]
Discover new events, effects and even new areas full of tension that will make it harder to keep your sanity.

In addition, you will find new zones completely redesigned with a more realistic atmosphere.

Do you dare to live this new experience? But be careful, because if your sanity is too low, the truth will be more likely to chase you...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44098675/6bbbb7ad96bae2162ea371d6201c4f00d7c77a39.png[/img]
